criteria.given: A broad typed model or malformed graph/reference/lifecycle
then: Valid models are accepted and duplicate/broken identities, illegal edges/cardinality/cycles, malformed fields and lifecycle conflicts produce precise nonmutating diagnostics

criteria.given: A valid Engineering Model with decisions and dependent tasks
criteria.when: A digest-bound semantic edit or concurrent stale edit is submitted
then: Through a pre/post-validated action, attributable history, revisions, blockers and transitive decision invalidation persist; invalid/stale changes cannot publish or overwrite the last stable state

criteria.given: Canonical scenario/test references and coordinator evidence, possibly missing, tampered or historical
criteria.when: Read-only scenario and evidence projection runs
then: Assertions, actual outcomes and revision provenance are inspected through existing authority; missing/invalid/historical evidence is honest and inspection writes nothing

criteria.given: One revisioned model used by agents and humans
criteria.when: Public CLI validates, projects JSON/Markdown and performs a decision journey
then: Both projections retain identical IDs/digest and task/attention state, useful errors preserve data and CLI edits survive reload

criteria.given: A validated workstream snapshot and canonical evidence references
then: UI displays canonical assertions/tests/revisions and honest evidence states, consuming the shared validated snapshot without duplicating domain-validation or repair rules

criteria.given: An attention item, valid/invalid decision form or concurrently changed definition
criteria.when: The developer records a reasoned choice then reloads, or submits a stale/invalid form
then: A valid choice persists and changes task attention; stale or invalid submissions reject without writes

criteria.given: Current and candidate document states, referenced specifications, external saves and concurrent changes
criteria.when: Any state-changing engineering action or specification change is admitted and published
then: Validate the current stable state before invoking the action and the complete resulting state afterward; failures or stale identities prevent publication
Every spec change invalidates affected validation, including linked-spec-only edits; startup/action/read checks recover from missed external-save events
Readers consume one validated generation, with content/dependency/rule-bound identity; incremental/cache behavior agrees with full validation and no broken or mixed state is actionable

Each enumerated public state-changing entry point uses the same guard; successful execution records exactly one pre-check, action, post-check and publication in order against captured input/result identities

criteria.given: An admitted model with optional parent/Story membership, related capabilities, shared Tasks and Tests
criteria.when: The developer navigates connected records from Epic, Story, Scenario or Task entry
then: Known context and qualified identities are preserved without requiring a complete hierarchy; shared Tasks/Tests have one canonical identity and missing links are visible without fabricated containment
Relevant purpose is explained before delivery/evidence; support relationships do not alter execution ownership or completion authority
Product and execution identities remain distinct; duplicate execution aliases reject, local support edges preserve one product identity, and foreign items resolve read-only in their owning model

criteria.given: A current checkout, local live work refs, archived works and unavailable or gitless sources
criteria.when: The workbench chooses its initial work or the developer browses another branch or revision
then: An explicitly selected valid Story/Task opens directly; otherwise recorded context/current branch locates the work or a labeled chooser is shown; checkout, selected subject and inspected source remain distinct

Committed cross-branch inspection reads one validated revision and its matching source/evidence without switching checkout, changing refs or enabling semantic edits; unavailable artifacts are explained

criteria.given: A decomposed task graph with scoped tests, actual runtime evidence, blockers and decisions
criteria.when: The developer filters tasks, opens a summary indicator or resolves an editable decision
then: Tasks expose readable outcomes, dependencies, supporting Story/Scenario links, same-revision specification passages and plan entries, scoped tests and recorded evidence, with absent context explicitly unavailable
Every summary count opens its exact records as a filter of the same hierarchy; blockers name their cause and decisions show available choices and guarded resolution
No missing history or declared done lifecycle is promoted to verified completion

criteria.given: A selected test, qualified source selector, execution history and current or historical candidate
criteria.when: The developer inspects source, outcomes, failures, run details and technical identifiers
then: Source is syntax highlighted and corresponds to the selected qualified test and revision; results match work, test, run and contract identities
Passed, failed, not run, unavailable, stale, historical, skipped and runtime-error states preserve actual meaning; missing time and duration are explicit
Debug identifiers remain collapsed initially and have explanations, copyable values and usable artifact links or commands; execution pass remains distinct from incomplete verification history
Readable setup/action/expected behavior and relevant same-revision helper/global definitions explain the assertion; narrative expected behavior remains distinct from actual retained observations

criteria.given: The workbench and recorded local performance baseline, including narrow and keyboard-only usage
criteria.when: The redesigned UI is exercised in a real browser with measured loading and navigation
then: Responsive list-detail navigation, accessible labels/focus/contrast and non-color status text allow the primary inspection and decision journeys
Initial Overview performs no test-source or evidence scan; selected detail loads lazily and cache refresh or changed inputs cannot hide stale or tampered evidence
Pilot latency budgets are measured with documented samples and misses; a technology replacement requires observed limitations and a reviewed amendment

criteria.given: A request references an existing Story/Task, a later/tracker item, conflicting candidates or no parent
criteria.when: Adopted work context is resolved and presented
then: Reuse known identity and state the bounded contribution/exclusions without creating an Epic or inventing ancestors
Material missing/conflicting scope is surfaced before work admission; unavailable external context does not silently become a known local item

The adopted agent/coordinator request intake invokes context resolution before branch creation, intent recording or work admission; explicit subject precedes recorded context, conflicts require clarification and inspection-only entry writes nothing

criteria.given: V1 historical records and proposed v2 optional-parent, shared-task and capability relationships
criteria.when: Definitions are validated or explicitly migrated
then: V2 accepts missing parents and the specified support edges while rejecting duplicate identities, illegal/multiple containment parents, broken links and cycles
V1 remains interpreted under its original version; migration preserves identities/evidence and requires explicit reviewed adoption without automatic browsing writes

Unsafe paths and malformed selectors invalidate admission; safe missing or ambiguous passages are context limitations, required-passage actions block, and invalid current state permits diagnostics and explicit repair only

criteria.given: A selected Task/Story with precise specification and plan passage references, including missing or ambiguous selectors
criteria.when: Context is inspected at a captured revision or referenced files change
then: Show the selected same-revision passages with source identity, or explicit missing/ambiguous context; do not silently substitute another passage
Referenced text participates in snapshot identity and linked-only changes invalidate freshness; inspection remains read-only

Concrete Scenario flow selects a canonical test-plan case at an exact digest; shared criteria alone never establish flow coverage; unique-to-ambiguous and missing-to-present passage changes invalidate freshness

criteria.given: A real pilot Test whose behavior may depend on helpers or global fixtures, with retained or missing evidence
criteria.when: The human follows the representative Story from Task to Test and outcome
then: Expose readable setup, action, expected behavior and assertion with necessary helper/global context at the selected revision
Actual recorded results and applicability are inspectable; missing evidence is explicitly incomplete and fixture runs are not mislabeled as pilot evidence

The specified historical WB-003 example must include at least one genuine integrity-checked retained result and a successful candidate-bound readability disposition; relevant source/context changes invalidate the review and unresolved failures block the demonstration

criteria.given: The older harness example and its retained historical definitions/evidence
criteria.when: The main pilot opens or the human explicitly selects historical work
then: The older harness is absent from the main pilot presentation while original records/evidence and explicit historical inspection are preserved

criteria.given: Repository-owned definitions and relationships, with an optional tracker reference
criteria.when: Work is inspected or its context is resolved
then: Repository inspection does not require a third-party service or duplicate editable backlog; source revision governs engineering context
Unavailable tracker information is labeled and no automatic API integration, synchronization or authority transfer occurs
